name: Keel Money
description: Keel, a personal-finance app's landing page on a night-navy ground: a brushed-silver headline ringed by drifting category pills, a paragraph that lights up word by word, spending and wealth bentos drawn as live app UI, a pale chapter that rises over the night, honest pricing and a wall of reviews.
designedFor: Launching a fintech, budgeting or personal-finance app
Product landing pages that show the app itself, drawn in HTML rather than screenshots
Dark, premium marketing sites with scroll-driven storytelling
Teams who want every chart, pill and panel editable from the canvas editor
